body.name: Singular finite-orbit bridge handle
body.construction: Start from the exact likelihood \(P_m(x\mid r)\); stratify local type counts by \((\theta,\eta)\); use a discrete Stein expansion only in the target coordinate; retain zero-likelihood cells through the primal risk inequalities; compactify duals as probability measures in \(\eta\) with fiberwise \(H^1\) control in \(\theta\); and construct liminf and recovery comparisons uniform on shrinking neighborhoods of \(\eta=0\).
